rl@15s.graded_on: heldout_score (mean_return on 64 held-out levels, higher is better)
rl@15s.formula: start_mean + 0.6 x (best_mean - start_mean) = -509.8, rounded toward the start (step 5)

alternatives.-165: 3/9 strong runs (A 2/3, C 1/3): same as the 30 s goal, slightly harder at 15 s

rl@15s.reason: Like the 30 s goal (README: 'the gap is a cliff, not a slope'), the formula value -510 sits on the cliff: any config with the reward-scale fix passes it, so it is not hard. -170 sits on the best-config plateau: the best replicated 15 s config reaches it in 2 of 3 single runs and only 3 of 9 strong-config runs do, so an arm must find a near-best config (hard) that the calibration shows exists (reachable). Chosen before any rl@15s race; frozen once a race uses it.
